A power supply with electromotive force (emf) and internal resistance is connected to a variable resistor. The resistance of the variable resistor is increased. Which row correctly describes the change in the terminal potential difference across the power supply and the current in the circuit?

|| Terminal potential difference | Current in the circuit |
|--| :--- | :--- |
|A| Increases | Decreases |
|B| Decreases | Decreases |
|C| Increases | Increases |
|D| Decreases | Increases |

  1. A
  2. B
  3. C
  4. D
